Overview

Woodbridge is a city in NJ with a population of 100,000. Middlesex County township with Menlo Park Mall and convenient NYC access. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees.
